description_en: Removes CC5G instances from a CC5G instance group
name: RemoveWirelessCloudConnectorFromGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the 5G Cloud Connector instances. You can specify up to 20 instance IDs
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_ids

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID of the API request as the client token. The request ID of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without updating the instance information. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the check, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request and directly updates the instance information after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新实例信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接更新实例信息
parameters.name: dry_run
